hint.title: How it works
hint.edit_select: Tap a room to select it. Tap next to it to let it go.
hint.edit_move: Drag the selected room to move it, the blue dots to resize it: it snaps to its neighbours on its own.
hint.edit_sheet: The pencil opens its details: name, colour, deletion.
hint.edit_door: Tap "Door", then a wall. Keep your finger down and slide: the opening is drawn as a dotted line before it is placed.
hint.edit_pin: One tap picks a chip, a drag places it, a double tap removes it from the plan. S / M / XL changes its size.
hint.navigate: Pinch to zoom, drag with one finger to pan. The fit button brings the whole plan back on screen.
hint.read_room: Tap a room to see what it holds.
hint.read_pin: Each chip is a storage spot in the room.
